content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text resolves a chain-vs-chain collision by calling it underdetermined for lack of explicit textual resolution, which is the kind of verse-level stating-verse demand K-C governs and retires.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"'that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires': (1) absence of an explicit contrary verse cannot by itself make a chain-vs-chain collision underdetermined; (2) it can still be underdetermined if chain footings are not weighed. I read K-C as (1) because it says weigh by footing, never verse by verse.","why":"The judge marks the link UNDERDETERMINED because paternity lacks explicit textual resolution, which leaves undone K-C's required chain-by-footing weighing and instead relies on the retired stating-verse test."}
